answerPassages.answer: NAS Pensacola guidance says students assigned for fewer than 140 classroom days need orders or other written authorization before bringing family. Read the official temporary-housing instructions . Confirm your own command and student status before arranging off-base housing or dependent travel.
answerPassages.caveat: Confirm your own command and student status before arranging off-base housing or dependent travel.

answerPassages.question: Does VA eligibility by itself make buying the right move?
answerPassages.answer: A VA purchase requires the applicable eligibility, lender credit and income standards, and residence requirements. The VA purchase guidance separates those conditions. Approval still does not determine whether the home fits your holding period, reserves and possible next assignment.
answerPassages.caveat: Approval still does not determine whether the home fits your holding period, reserves and possible next assignment.
